exposure: receipt of information about body shape
body mass index (BMI) at six months postpartum
spouse's views on the shape of a woman's body
cohort: 300 women who referred to seven health centers affiliated with Iran University of Medical Sciences, Tehran, Iran
finding: Body dissatisfaction at six months postpartum was significantly associated with body mass index at six months postpartum, gestational age, the receipt of information about body shape, spouse's views on the shape of a woman's body, and mode of delivery.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was found to be associated with body dissatisfaction at six months postpartum.
